name: autonomous-youtube-studio
description: Autonomous YouTube video production studio producing high-CPM, trend-backed videos and Shorts with multi-agent debate and compliance verification.
conventions: Each agent operates with distinct role and criteria
Every fact and metric must have verifiable source in sources.md
All debates must be logged in debate_logs/ with minimum 2 rounds before approval
Compliance Agent holds veto power on policy, copyright, and brand safety
Monetization Analyst acts as ultimate tiebreaker after round 3
architecture_patterns: Multi-agent debate loop (Producer vs Critic vs Compliance)
Modular pipeline: Trend Research -> Monetization -> Scriptwriting -> Production -> SEO
Pure local synthesis: FFmpeg + edge-tts neural voice + high-contrast visual composition

file_structure.output/<topic-slug>: Rendered MP4s, thumbnail, script, metadata, and research
file_structure.debate_logs: Markdown logs of multi-agent debate rounds per production stage

patterns: Verification of audio/video sync, frame rate, and aspect ratio (16:9 and 9:16)
Strict compliance check against YouTube Advertiser-Friendly and Spam policies

never_do: Never use copyrighted audio, music, video clips, or unauthorized images
Never fabricate statistics or metrics without citation
Never make promises of virality; output realistic viral potential scores with risks
Never bypass Critic debate or Compliance veto gates
Never output unprompted recaps, step-by-step changelogs, or repetitive summaries that waste tokens
Never leave completed work uncommitted or unpushed to GitHub
preferred_patterns: Practice extreme token economy: keep responses concise, high-signal, and directly answer user requests
Use edge-tts neural voices (e.g., en-US-ChristopherNeural or en-US-GuyNeural) for clear, broadcast-grade delivery
Generate high-contrast, clickable thumbnails optimized for mobile CTR
Enforce YouTube YPP reused content policy by ensuring substantial original commentary and value-add
